environment.semantics: Salias FIFO per-publisher rings and Aeron exclusive publications; multiple subscribers receive every published message (fanout), not competing consumers
environment.capacity: Salias 1 MiB per-producer ring versus Aeron 1 MiB term in a multi-term log; total mapped capacities differ
environment.aggregation: Median and range across measured run values; latency uses each run's worst subscriber, never pooled histograms
environment.payload_limit: Logical payloads are 64/256 B; latency writes 16 B and throughput 8 B. Counts and samples are checked, not full content, sequence, or duplicate logic
